title: RaPD: Resolution-Agnostic Pixel Diffusion via Semantics-Enriched Implicit Representations
abstract: arXiv:2605.15908v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Natural images are continuous, yet most generative models synthesize them on discrete grids, limiting resolution-flexible generation. Continuous neural fields enable resolution-free rendering, but prior methods introduce continuity only at the decoding stage as an interpolation module, leaving the generative latent space discretized and reconstruction-oriented. We propose RaPD (Resolution-agnostic Pixel Diffusion), which performs diffusion in a continuous Neural Image Field (NIF) latent space. RaPD bridges this reconstruction generation gap with Semantic Representation Guidance for generation-aware latent learning and a Coordinate-Queried Attention Renderer for coordinate-conditioned, scale-aware rendering. A single denoised latent can be rendered at arbitrary resolutions by changing only the query coordinates, keeping diffusion cost fixed. Experiments demonstrate superior generation quality and resolution scalability.

translated_title: RaPD：基于语义增强隐式表示的分辨率无关像素扩散
translated_abstract: 自然图像本质上是连续的，但大多数生成模型在离散网格上合成图像，限制了分辨率灵活的生成。连续神经场虽然能够实现无分辨率限制的渲染，但先前的方法仅在解码阶段将连续性作为插值模块引入，导致生成潜空间仍然是离散化的且面向重建的。我们提出了RaPD（分辨率无关像素扩散），它在连续的神经图像场（NIF）潜空间中执行扩散。RaPD通过用于生成感知潜空间学习的语义表示引导，以及用于坐标条件化、尺度感知渲染的坐标查询注意力渲染器，弥合了重建与生成之间的差距。通过仅改变查询坐标，单个去噪后的潜变量即可按任意分辨率进行渲染，同时保持扩散成本固定。实验证明了该方法具有卓越的生成质量和分辨率可扩展性。
tldr: RaPD提出在连续的神经图像场潜空间中进行像素扩散，通过语义表示引导和坐标查询注意力渲染器，使单个去噪潜变量可通过仅改变查询坐标按任意分辨率渲染，且扩散成本保持固定。
en_tdlr: RaPD performs pixel diffusion in a continuous Neural Image Field latent space, using semantic representation guidance and a coordinate-queried attention renderer so that a single denoised latent can be rendered at arbitrary resolutions with fixed diffusion cost.
